title: Main theorem applied to classical groups
body_html:
Main theorem applied to classical groups

Theorem (synthesis). Let $G$ be a classical group over a $p$-adic field with $p \ne 2$, $\Phi$ a Stevens semisimple character with associated Levi $M = G^\beta$. The §8 main theorem Main Theorem 8.2.1: Rep_Φ(G) ≃ Rep_0(M) yields an equivalence $$\Rep_\Phi(G) \;\simeq\; \Rep_0(M).$$

Status. Statement accepted. Proof accepted modulo the status of the global $\beta$-extension existence (formerly listed as [HKSS Conjecture 7.8]):

  • All axioms (T1)–(T5), (S), (E1)–(E3) (local), (K1)–(K4) are established in the Stevens-school literature (BK, Sécherre–Stevens, Stevens, Miyauchi–Stevens, Skodlerack–Stevens, KSS, HKSS).
  • The global $\beta$-extension compatibility — needed to make the $\kappa_x$ data into a literal $G$-equivariant family — is addressed by the Skodlerack–Ye preprint in the quaternionic case (Thm 5.21 of [SkoYe]; see Global β-extension existence (compatible κ-family on B(G_β)) and Skodlerack–Ye: compatible families of β-extensions (Thm 5.21)). The same quadratic-correction technique is expected to extend to the general classical case, but neither extension nor the preprint is published.
proof_html:
All axioms required by [[node:depth_zero_reduction.main_theorem|Main Theorem 8.2.1]] are verified for classical-groups Stevens data:

Axiom Source
(K1)–(K3) [[node:applications.classical_K1_K2_K3]] (uses [Stevens:SC §3], [BK 3.3.4] enveloping-$\widetilde G$ argument)
(T1)–(T5) [[node:applications.classical_T_axioms]] (uses [Stevens:SC §3], [KSS Prop 8.13], [Schneider–Stuhler §II.2] (NOT BL Cor 4.5 — earlier KB drafts misattributed; BL Cor 4.5 is a lattice/ramification computation, unrelated))
(S) Hypothesis (S) for classical groups via [HKSS] (= [HKSS Prop 6.7], building on [BK93]/[SS:IV,VI]/[Stevens:SC]/[Sko:SS]/[KSS21])
(E1)–(E3) (locally) [Stevens:SC §3], [Stevens:SC §4.2], [MS §3]
(E3) (globally) Global β-extension existence (compatible κ-family on B(G_β)) = [SkoYe Thm 5.21] (preprint, quaternionic case; general classical case in progress)
(K4) Standard, from Stevens decomposition; cf. [Stevens:SC §3] and [HKSS §5]

With all axioms in place, [Sheaf7 Thm 8.2.1] applies directly. $\square$

Honest accounting. This statement is as unconditional as it currently can be: every axiom has a published proof or a clearly identified preprint. When [SkoYe] appears in print (and the general classical extension is documented), the conditional language can be removed; until then, "global $\beta$-extension existence" is a preprint-conditional input.
